svg.text: A deep fjord: the port at its head where the rail comes down the valley, a shore on each side under the walls, the sea and the Lily at its mouth.

g.text: the port: station, hotel, bank, chapel

svg.text: The water splits the map: north shore and south shore, joined
only by the head bridge and a chain ferry. Long rifle fights
across the fjord; each shore is its own run out to the sea.
Train down the valley to Fjord Head
Win the marker: the Gilded Parlor, south side
The launch from the north-shore pier
a bounty fought on the raft
THE GILDED LILY · THE DECKS WE PLAY
true scale: 180 m long, 24 m across · bow to the right · the launch puts you at the starboard gangway
UPPER DECKS · promenade, lifeboats, funnels, bridge
